question: What offerings of fruit and sacred ash should be made upon the liṅga?
premises: An occasional offering of fruit and other items is given.
Sacred ash is applied to the liṅga.
The ash is scattered upon the liṅga.
inference: One should give the fruit offering and scatter sacred ash upon the liṅga.
plain_english: One should give the occasional offering of fruit and so forth, and scatter sacred ash upon the liṅga.
